## 1stDibs to Participate in Upcoming Investor Conference


11/10/2026


[Download (opens in new window) PDF 69 KB](https://s203.q4cdn.com/756296962/files/doc_news/1stDibs-to-Participate-in-Upcoming-Investor-Conference-ab4201b7d-2026.pdf)


NEW YORK--(BUSINESS WIRE)--


1stdibs.com, Inc. (Nasdaq: DIBS), a leading online marketplace for luxury design products, announced today that CEO David Rosenblatt and CFO Tom Etergino will present at the Southwest IDEAS Conference in Dallas on Wednesday, November 18 at 5:40 PM ET.


A replay of the webcast will be available on the 1stDibs investor relations website for one year.


About 1stDibs
1stDibs is a leading online marketplace for connecting design lovers with highly coveted sellers and makers of vintage, antique, and contemporary furniture, home décor, art, jewelry, watches, and fashion.

Kevin LaBuz, Head of Investor Relations & Corporate Development
